description: Suprime-Cam was the wide-field prime-focus camera on the Subaru Telescope. These are its general broad-band filters: Johnson-Cousins B, V, Rc and Ic, SDSS g', r', i' and z', and Y.
facility_description: Suprime-Cam was the prime-focus camera of the Subaru Telescope, operated by the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan.
notes: The sensitivity page states the magnitude systems explicitly: Vega for Johnson-Cousins, AB for the SDSS filters and for Y. It also says a throughput estimate should fold in the FDCCD quantum efficiency, the Primary Focus Unit transmittance and the primary-mirror reflectivity; those are not in the filter-only lists. Miyazaki et al. 2002 is the camera paper and predates the Y filter, so Y is not given that paper as a profile reference. Bessell 1990 and Fukugita et al. 1996 are the photometric-system papers, not the scan sources.
